description: t.a opens r.1 with an envelope of 1024 memory bytes, 100 CPU units and a 50-poll cleanup budget and reads it back from the region. The task t.b it spawns into r.1 carries that envelope (the child's principal Cx, state.rs:5123-5130), and the region r.2 t.b opens asks for more memory (4096), fewer CPU units (25) and an I/O envelope it has none of (10): the child gets the tighter memory and CPU, the cleanup budget it inherits and the I/O it asked for.
